findings.text: The skill says a capacity_exceeded call should be retried 'once after about a call', while every ICP tool description in the saved live tool list says 'retry it once after about a second'; the advice as written is not actionable. The gate checks names and schema vocabulary only, so it cannot redden on this prose slip.

The ICPRecords row claims the skill cites search_components and search_function_categories (records.py:222 and :227), but SKILL.md:203-206 cites neither; both methods exist at those lines, yet the table overstates what the skill names, so a reader cannot tell which of the ten listed methods is actually cited.

The fragment states the skill holds 'no host, person or document title', but the listed checks (verify_skill.py identity regex \b[A-Z0-9]{6}\b, dotted two-part code, iter.org) cannot fail on a real document title such as the live 'GDC I&C signal list' or a person name, so that clause of the done_when is asserted rather than measured.
